read_first: unit capability only when combat/training capability matters
home establishment series when the unit is still cold/unmaterialized
write_order: apply split/merge/refit/training/casualty transaction to authoritative unit state
rebuild unit index and any derived capability cache
invariants: One unit is one troop type.
One durable standard loadout per unit.
Partial durable differences require a split first.
Aggregate unit math remains the large-battle representation; never expand ordinary troops into thousands of people.
